instrument: Measure the voiced fraction of active sound before a join. Exclude intervals with under 200 ms of active sound. On the original held-out laughs fit a within-speaker linear probability model, then add level and prior laughter, then meeting effects. A coefficient is the probability difference per unit of voiced fraction. Repeat descriptively on all eligible laughs. Use 2,000 whole-meeting draws for intervals and 1,000 within-speaker, within-meeting shuffles for the first model. The control rows give the 95th percentile and the upper-tail permutation probability. The earlier ICSI component profile uses whole annotated utterances.
